name: Facilities, Fleet & IT Service Management (ITSM) Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Facilities Management, Fleet Operations, and IT Service Management (ITIL ITSM), covering corporate space allocation, facilities work requests, fleet vehicle acquisition/maintenance, ITIL Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration (CMDB), and Release management.

checklists.name: Facilities, Fleet & ITSM Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for facilities work orders, fleet inspections, ITIL incident management, CAB change control, and CMDB tracking.

items.statement: Facilities work requests log building location, asset ID, priority, and vendor maintenance SLA.
Fleet vehicles undergo scheduled preventive maintenance and fuel card usage audits.
ITIL Incident Management logs impact/urgency and drives root-cause Problem Management investigations.
Change Advisory Board (CAB) evaluates production change risk, implementation plan, and rollback procedures.
Configuration Management Database (CMDB) maps relationship dependencies across hardware, software, and services.

reviewGates.name: VP of IT & Facilities Operations Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The VP of IT & Facilities Operations confirms that facilities maintenance, fleet tracking, and ITIL CAB change controls satisfy operational benchmarks.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the documentation confirm ITIL change control compliance and facilities SLA performance?

obligationDefinitions.title: A major ITSM incident requires a completed post-incident review
obligationDefinitions.description: ITIL practice requires a Major Incident to be followed by a Post-Incident Review identifying root cause and preventive action; closing the incident ticket alone does not satisfy this.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every Major Incident has a completed Post-Incident Review with recorded preventive actions.

requiredEvidence.title: Post-incident review record
requiredEvidence.description: Completed Post-Incident Review document for the Major Incident.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has a Post-Incident Review been completed for this Major Incident?
